Plus the next Annual Conference from /annual-conference/ whose dates come from the organiser's linked rate-card PDF. concerns: Listing /courses/ (7 dated courses/webinar) + the Annual Conference 2027 = 8 shells. The conference has no dated text on its own page ('watch this space'); the dates come from the organiser's own linked exhibitor rate-card PDF. If that PDF disappears the conference row is not emitted (never guessed).

Coverage checklist: fees verified per course on each EventsAir microsite (the booking_url IS the fee page). Empty tiers justified: the Managing Early Sudden Cardiac Death webinar shows no price on its page (registration form is JS, 'Loading agenda...'); the Annual Conference has no delegate fees yet (the rate card prices exhibition stands only, which the harness flags as PRICE_SAME_SITE_LINK: a false positive for attendee fees). No image fee tables, no two-hop sites seen.
Cardio-Oncology course page says 'REGISTRATION CLOSED: DEADLINE 17.00HRS ON MONDAY 9 NOVEMBER 2026' (today); the event (16 Nov) is kept, is_sold_out not set (closed is not sold out).

EventsAir pages differ per course; fee lines are parsed from the block under 'Pricing:' / 'Attendance fee' (regular/early-bird on one line supported). A new layout (e.g. a table) would give no tiers, not wrong ones. Early-bird deadlines are not stated on the pages (promo codes only), so early_bird_deadline is null.

Webinars are event_type workshop, other courses course. cpd_accredited left unset: pages say CPD 'is being applied for'. Members' fees are public here. robots.txt crawl-delay 10: only 2 own-site pages + 1 PDF per run; each course lives on its own EventsAir host.
No LLM calls; description is the first real paragraph. Tests: test_bcs.py.
